# O*NET 31.0 representative fixture

Selected, unmodified source rows from the supplied O*NET 31.0 CSV database
(August 2026), archive SHA-256
`55033fc68b4c13ec23e7f74dc6378660f6e854e75d55d6e333ae0a761d3987cd`.
Most datasets retain two rows; ratings include representative element/scale
combinations and negative WI values. Reference closure and small category tables
are retained. This is NOT full-package verification evidence.

O*NET Database: National Center for O*NET Development, CC BY 4.0.
Source: https://www.onetcenter.org/database.html
License: https://www.onetcenter.org/license_db.html
Changes: subset selection and JSON serialization for test fixtures; source field
values are preserved. Tests deliberately mutate copies for negative cases.
